name: Kraft Crayon Zine
summary: A 3:4 vertical (1080×1440) Kyoto-style kraft-paper sketchbook zine: warm wheat-brown kraft paper (#D5BE9E) with torn-edge cream 5mm grid-paper note patches (#F7F3E8), translucent diagonal-striped washi tape (matcha & terracotta), deep espresso brown wax crayon outlines (#2B1E16), luminous creamy white wax crayon highlights & resist (#FFFDF7) that pop directly on the toned kraft stock, persimmon red / mustard / sage / dusty-blue crayons, amber-tea watercolour washes, and live crayon circle/arrow study annotations.
